senses.gloss: to be slender, small; to be reduced, diminished.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 10:27">Targ. Prov. X, 27</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00593"><he>זְעִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 29:6">Targ. Jer. XXIX, 6</cite>; a. fr.—
Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵃ bot. זַעֲרַת ולא ז׳ וכ׳ it (the measure) was reduced, but was not made as small as it had been before; v. Ithpe.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>ותִזְעַר נפשיה</he> and he may get sick.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 18:16">Targ. II Sam. XVIII, 16</cite> ed. Lag. a. Ar. (ed. <he>מנע</he>; h. text <he>חשך</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 16:17">Targ. Ex. XVI, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 16:18">18</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M02097"><he>הִמְעִיט</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 25:16">Targ. Lev. XXV, 16</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:6">Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 6</cite> <he>לאַזְעוֹרֵיה</he> to reduce (defeat) him (h. text <he>נכה</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:4">Targ. O. Ex. XII, 4</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:16">Targ. Y. Gen. I, 16</cite>.—Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ top [read:] <he>אִזְּעִירָא ולא אִזְּעָרַת וכ׳</he> it was reduced, but not made as small &c., v. supra.
